description.value:
A capacity attachment: it adds rounds to the weapon's base capacity, by weapon type: Pistol (all) +18, SMG (all) +20, Crossbow +11, Shotgun +12, Assault Rifle +25, Machine Gun +40, Sniper Rifle +8, Grenade Launcher +4, Rocket Launcher +2.

One capacity attachment per weapon. Crossbows can take one too; a loaded crossbow magazine holds one arrow type (you can still hand-load another with a free hand).

Item Compendium (2070) • Attachments & Mods
